checks.title: HTML pages are present
checks.description: At least one HTML page is found in the source repository.

checks.title: Descriptive page titles
checks.description: HTML pages include non-empty title elements.

checks.title: Meta descriptions
checks.description: HTML pages include meta descriptions.

checks.title: H1 headings
checks.description: HTML pages include a clear H1 heading.

checks.title: HTML language attribute
checks.description: HTML documents declare their language.

checks.title: Mobile viewport
checks.description: HTML documents declare a responsive viewport.

checks.title: Canonical URLs
checks.description: HTML pages declare canonical URLs.

checks.title: Robots meta directives
checks.description: No accidental noindex directive is detected.

checks.title: Open Graph metadata
checks.description: Open Graph title and description metadata are present.

checks.title: Twitter card metadata
checks.description: Twitter card metadata is present.

checks.title: Image ALT text
checks.description: Image elements include non-empty ALT attributes.

checks.title: Structured data
checks.description: JSON-LD or microdata is present.

checks.title: XML sitemap
checks.description: A sitemap file is present in the repository.

checks.title: robots.txt
checks.description: A robots.txt file is present in the repository.

checks.title: HTTPS canonical references
checks.description: Absolute canonical and sitemap URLs use HTTPS.

checks.title: Heading structure
checks.description: Pages use headings in a logical order and include H1.

checks.title: Image loading hints
checks.description: Checks eager/high-priority treatment for clearly identified hero images and lazy loading for clearly identified below-the-fold images; ambiguous image positions remain unknown.

checks.title: CSS external imports
checks.description: Stylesheets avoid excessive CSS @import usage.

checks.title: No HTTP asset references
checks.description: Source does not reference insecure HTTP assets.

checks.title: Social sharing image
checks.description: Open Graph image metadata is present.

checks.title: Title length
checks.description: Checks static page titles against an advisory display-length range.

checks.title: Unique page titles
checks.description: Detects duplicate title text across audited pages.

checks.title: Meta description length
checks.description: Checks available descriptions against an advisory length range.

checks.title: Unique meta descriptions
checks.description: Detects duplicate descriptions across audited pages.

checks.title: Single H1 structure
checks.description: Flags multiple static H1 elements; one H1 is a structural recommendation, not a strict ranking rule.

checks.title: Descriptive link text
checks.description: Finds anchors without visible text or an accessible label.

checks.title: Internal linking
checks.description: Checks for local navigation links in public pages.

checks.title: Broken internal HTML links
checks.description: Compares local HTML link targets with the generated repository file list.

checks.title: URL-friendly file paths
checks.description: Checks URL-addressable public pages and browser assets, excluding repository documentation and configuration files.

checks.title: Sitemap structure
checks.description: Checks sitemap XML well-formedness and root element.

checks.title: Sitemap reference in robots.txt
checks.description: Checks for a Sitemap directive; recommended, not mandatory.

checks.title: Single canonical per page
checks.description: Checks exactly one canonical link on each audited page.

checks.title: Absolute HTTPS canonical
checks.description: Checks canonical URLs are absolute HTTPS addresses.

checks.title: Hreflang annotations
checks.description: Checks hreflang only when multilingual or regional variants are detected; otherwise marked not applicable.

checks.title: Valid JSON-LD syntax
checks.description: Parses JSON-LD blocks as JSON; does not validate schema vocabulary.

checks.title: Image width and height
checks.description: Checks whether images declare dimensions to reserve layout space.

checks.title: Modern image formats
checks.description: Detects WebP or AVIF references; absence is not treated as failure.

checks.title: Parser-blocking scripts
checks.description: Finds classic scripts in the document head without defer or async.

checks.title: Semantic page landmarks
checks.description: Checks for main and nav landmarks in public pages.

checks.title: Complete Open Graph metadata
checks.description: Checks Open Graph description, type and URL.
